Young the older director). The agent got stuck in a loop of searching for the second variable instead of using the already found variable (1979 film release) to deduce the age constraint. The confidence in the analysis is high because the trace clearly contradicts the 'failed to recognize task complete' narrative by showing explicit acknowledgment of the 1979 date while simultaneously ignoring its implications.
